pages.text: Create's $(thing)andesite alloy$(), as the name implies, requires $(l:the_world/geology#igneous_extrusive)andesite$() to craft. However, in the world of TerraFirmaCraft it is much harder to find, and realistically speaking, an alloy made of igneous rocks shouldn't be possible.$(br) That is why this modpack renames it as $(thing)mechanical alloy$() and adds a more realistic way of obtaining it.

pages.title: Mechanical Alloy Items
pages.text: $(thing)Mechanical alloy$() has been turned into a TFC metal - That means it has ingots, double ingots, sheets, double sheets and rods, and can be forged using an $(l:mechanics/anvils)anvil$().

pages.title: Making mechanical alloy
pages.text: In order to make mechanical alloy you need a few things:$(br)$(li)A $(l:mechanics/crucible)crucible$() or $(l:getting_started/pottery#vessel)vessel$().$()$(li)A $(l:mechanics/bellows)way$() of reaching $(d)Brilliant White$() (1650ºC) temperatures.$()$(li)And of course, the $(thing)ingredients$():$(li2)70-80% of $(thing)cast iron$().$(li2)10-20% of $(thing)Zinc$().$(li2)0-10% of $(thing)copper$().$()
